description: Release/drift-tooling registry for operation ids that are not part of the current v1 operation contract. Current HTTP/gRPC/MQ bindings consume the active operation registry and OpenAPI binding; conformance scanners may consume this file for negative drift tests and release audit. This is CI/release drift-detection tooling, not a current-wire normative contract: every entry is hard-reject on the wire, there is no migration/compat tolerance window and no offline migration layer; removed ids MAY appear only in changelog documentation and in cotest negative drift fixtures that assert rejection.

rejection_levels.hard_reject: MUST NOT appear in any current operation registry, OpenAPI document, gRPC schema, or SDK call site.
rejection_levels.docs_only: Removed from machine surfaces; survives in CHANGELOG / migration notes.

allowed_context_definitions.changelog: Reference in CHANGELOG or migration documentation.
allowed_context_definitions.negative_test: Reference in cotest drift fixtures that assert rejection.
